subject: Kickoff: Dichotomy of Control for reliable automation agents
body:
Deshawn, team,

Kicking off the DoC evaluation track. Why it matters for us: return-conditioned agents like Decision Transformer quietly take credit for lucky outcomes in stochastic environments, which is exactly the failure mode we cannot afford in the ops-automation agents. Dichotomy of Control separates what the policy controls from what the environment decides, and the released code makes the contrast easy to demonstrate -- flipping algo_name from doc to dt in run_tabular.sh shows the dramatic performance drop on the tabular benchmarks.

Scope for the half: reproduce the Bandit and FrozenLake results from the offline datasets, then a neural DoC run on one internal ops simulator, wrapping by June 8 with a go/no-go recommendation for Q3 adoption.

Deshawn to size staffing and infra.

Ulla
